BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to an AfghanistanIraq war memorial; adding a newsection to chapter 73.40 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It is the intent of the legislature to honorand recognize the dedication and sacrifices made by the men and womenof Washington state who were killed or missing in action during theAfghanistan and Iraq wars against terrorism.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 73.40 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The director of the department of veterans affairs shallcoordinate the design, construction, and placement of a memorial withinthe state capitol grounds, honoring Washington state residents who werekilled or missing in action in the Afghanistan and Iraq wars. (2) The AfghanistanIraq war memorial account is created in thecustody of the state treasurer. All receipts from appropriations andprivate donations must be deposited into the account. Expendituresfrom the account may be used only for the AfghanistanIraq warmemorial. Only the director of the department of veterans affairs or p. 1 HB 1020the director's designee may authorize expenditures from the account.The account is subject to allotment procedures under chapter 43.88 RCW,but an appropriation is not required for expenditures.
